page.overview:
Who is Albert Tyler?

The crime syndicate Les Mille Yeux tried to blackmail him with the picture. Dee found out and confronted him with it, and he explained it all. He had always been afraid it would come out, and rather than orchestrate a cover-up, he resigned. This had been the goal of Les Mille Yeux, which was led by Beau. The next step would be to go after the new Phantom Lady and kill her.
